Μὴ οὐκ ἰσχύει ἡ χεὶρ κυρίου τοῦ σῶσαι; is rendered as the rhetorical question 'Is the Lord's hand not strong enough to save?' (Isa 59:1, expecting the answer that it is). Ezekiel 21:3-4 and 20:47 are the English verse numbers of the quoted LXX passages (LXX 21:8-9 and 21:3). The Septuagint sigla (ο') are now rendered. The Jeremiah sentence belongs to this section in the Greek. 'You led the people … as sheep led by Moses and Aaron' reproduces the simile. 'The interpreters', 'set that question aside', 'plea', 'appeal' and 'once called holy' are idiomatic renderings of ὁ μὲν … ὁ δέ … ἄλλοι, ταύτην ἐάσαντες, ἔντευξις, παράκλησις and κληθεῖσα.
